name: an5-example
description: Example usage and integration tests for AN5 ORM - schema, generated clients (TypeScript/Go/.NET/Python/Rust/Java/Kotlin/Swift), all adapter dialects, and browser support.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:suite && npm run test:browser && npm run test:example:ts && npm run test:go && npm run test:example:go && npm run test:dotnet && npm run test:example:dotnet && npm run test:python && npm run test:rust && npm run test:java && npm run test:kotlin && npm run test:swift
scripts.test:python: (python -m compileall -q examples/python || python3 -m compileall -q examples/python) && (python examples/python/crud.py || python3 examples/python/crud.py)
